seasons.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
seasons.quote: Planting is done during July – October

tree_spacing_m.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
tree_spacing_m.quote: Dig pits of size 45 cm x 45 cm x 45 cm with a spacing of 2.0 - 2.5 m either way.

years_to_bear.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
years_to_bear.note: About 0.3 year (the page spells it 'Harveting'). Annual moringa; the tree is cut back and ratooned for 3 years.

water_need.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
water_need.quote: subsequently at 10 – 15 days interval according to soil type.
water_need.note: Interpreted: watering once a week is read as 'low', every few days as 'medium'; no source uses the low/medium/high scale. Agronomist to confirm.

source_notes: AI research batch 6 (2026-10-07). Ranges are stored at their lower bound unless a note says otherwise; the source range is in each quote. Sow windows are TNAU plains months (Tamil Nadu) until a Malwa source is found.
